Title: AI policy
What it asks (paraphrased): A documented policy for developing or using AI systems
Justification: Cypher uses three AI systems (AIS-01 to AIS-03).
Evidence held / required: Held: CGI-POL-001 s4.5 (four clauses on staff use; a fragment). Required: AI policy v1.0.

Title: Alignment with other organizational policies
What it asks (paraphrased): Know where other policies touch AI and keep them consistent
Justification: AI use touches acceptable use, classification and supplier policies.
Evidence held / required: Held: s4.5 sits inside CGI-POL-001 and uses CGI-POL-004 classes. Required: evidence of a consistency review.

Title: Review of the AI policy
What it asks (paraphrased): Review the AI policy at planned intervals and on change
Justification: Needed once an AI policy exists.
Evidence held / required: Held: CGI-POL-001 annual review date. Required: review criteria covering new tools and legal change (the Omnibus rewrote Art. 4).

Title: AI roles and responsibilities
What it asks (paraphrased): Define and allocate AI roles
Justification: Owners exist per tool; nobody owns AI governance.
Evidence held / required: Held: CTO list-keeper role (s4.5.1). Required: AI lead, impact-assessment owner, reviewers.

Title: Reporting of concerns
What it asks (paraphrased): A way for people to report concerns about an AI system
Justification: Staff and customers see AI output first.
Evidence held / required: Held: CGI-POL-005 incident reporting (not AI-specific). Required: AI concern category and route.

Title: Resource documentation
What it asks (paraphrased): Document the resources each AI system relies on
Justification: A deployer must know what each system uses and touches.
Evidence held / required: Held: AI register drafted here. Required: register approved and kept current.

Title: Data resources
What it asks (paraphrased): Document the data each AI system uses
Justification: Applicable to the data Cypher feeds in.
Evidence held / required: Held: data-in column of the AI register (from the CGI-TPR-001 inventory). Required: owner confirmation.

Title: Tooling resources
What it asks (paraphrased): Document tools used to build AI systems
Justification: Not applicable while Cypher develops no AI system (AI register, Part 2). Becomes applicable at the AI-A01 design gate (AIG-13).

Title: System and computing resources
What it asks (paraphrased): Document computing resources used by AI systems
Justification: Not applicable while Cypher develops no AI system (AI register, Part 2). Becomes applicable at the AI-A01 design gate (AIG-13). For supplier AI the computing is the supplier's.

Title: Human resources
What it asks (paraphrased): Document the people and competences AI systems need
Justification: Oversight needs competent reviewers.
Evidence held / required: Held: none. Required: AI roles in the competence matrix.

Title: AI system impact assessment process
Group: A.5 Assessing impacts of AI systems
What it asks (paraphrased): A process to assess consequences for people and society
Justification: Two systems process people's conversations.
Evidence held / required: Held: process drafted in Part 5. Required: approval; trigger in CGI-TPR-001.

Title: Documentation of AI system impact assessments
Group: A.5 Assessing impacts of AI systems
What it asks (paraphrased): Record and keep impact assessment results
Justification: Same.
Evidence held / required: Held: AIIA-01 and AIIA-02 (this document). Required: owner approval; retention rule.

Title: Assessing impacts on individuals or groups
Group: A.5 Assessing impacts of AI systems
What it asks (paraphrased): Assess effects on individuals and groups
Justification: Customers and staff are recorded on calls.
Evidence held / required: Held: harm tables in AIIA-01 and AIIA-02. Required: approval.

Title: Assessing societal impacts of AI systems
Group: A.5 Assessing impacts of AI systems
What it asks (paraphrased): Assess wider effects on society
Justification: Required by the process even when the answer is small.
Evidence held / required: Held: societal section in AIIA-01 and AIIA-02 (negligible at this scale). Required: approval.

Title: Objectives for responsible development of AI systems
What it asks (paraphrased): Objectives that guide AI development
Justification: Not applicable while Cypher develops no AI system (AI register, Part 2). Becomes applicable at the AI-A01 design gate (AIG-13).

Title: Processes for responsible design and development
What it asks (paraphrased): Processes for responsible design and development
Justification: Not applicable while Cypher develops no AI system (AI register, Part 2). Becomes applicable at the AI-A01 design gate (AIG-13).

Title: AI system requirements and specification
What it asks (paraphrased): Specify requirements for new AI systems
Justification: Not applicable while Cypher develops no AI system (AI register, Part 2). Becomes applicable at the AI-A01 design gate (AIG-13). Buying supplier AI is governed by A.10.3.

Title: Documentation of AI system design and development
What it asks (paraphrased): Document design and development
Justification: Not applicable while Cypher develops no AI system (AI register, Part 2). Becomes applicable at the AI-A01 design gate (AIG-13).

Title: AI system verification and validation
What it asks (paraphrased): Check the system works as intended before use
Justification: A deployer should test a tool on its own calls before trusting it. Nobody has checked ScribeCo's accuracy.
Evidence held / required: Held: none. Required: an acceptance test (sample of summaries checked against recordings).

Title: AI system deployment
What it asks (paraphrased): Plan deployment and confirm requirements are met first
Justification: Every tool Cypher puts into use is a deployment.
Evidence held / required: Held: none; two tools arrived on expenses. Required: deployment checklist in the onboarding workflow.

Title: AI system operation and monitoring
What it asks (paraphrased): Operate and monitor the system, including errors and misuse
Justification: Output errors are the AR-001 risk.
Evidence held / required: Held: none. Required: review log sample; error reporting.

Title: AI system technical documentation
What it asks (paraphrased): Technical documentation for users and others
Justification: Not applicable while Cypher develops no AI system (AI register, Part 2). Becomes applicable at the AI-A01 design gate (AIG-13). Supplier documentation is collected under A.8.2 and A.10.3.

Title: AI system recording of event logs
What it asks (paraphrased): Keep event logs for the system
Justification: Cypher should know who used which tool on which meeting.
Evidence held / required: Held: none. Required: admin usage export kept 6 months.

Title: Data for development and enhancement of AI systems
What it asks (paraphrased): Manage data used to build or improve AI
Justification: Not applicable while Cypher develops no AI system (AI register, Part 2). Becomes applicable at the AI-A01 design gate (AIG-13). A supplier training on Cypher's data is a supplier control (A.10.3, VR-006).

Title: Acquisition of data
What it asks (paraphrased): Govern how training data is acquired
Justification: Not applicable while Cypher develops no AI system (AI register, Part 2). Becomes applicable at the AI-A01 design gate (AIG-13).

Title: Quality of data for AI systems
What it asks (paraphrased): Define and meet data quality requirements
Justification: Not applicable while Cypher develops no AI system (AI register, Part 2). Becomes applicable at the AI-A01 design gate (AIG-13).

Title: Data provenance
What it asks (paraphrased): Record where data came from
Justification: Not applicable while Cypher develops no AI system (AI register, Part 2). Becomes applicable at the AI-A01 design gate (AIG-13).

Title: Data preparation
What it asks (paraphrased): Define how data is prepared
Justification: Not applicable while Cypher develops no AI system (AI register, Part 2). Becomes applicable at the AI-A01 design gate (AIG-13).

Title: System documentation and information for users
What it asks (paraphrased): Give users the information they need to use the system properly
Justification: Staff need to know what each tool may and may not be used for.
Evidence held / required: Held: none; no AI-use instruction (OFI-04). Required: one-page use guide per approved tool.

Title: External reporting
What it asks (paraphrased): Let outside parties report adverse impacts
Justification: Customers are the first to see a wrong summary.
Evidence held / required: Held: none. Required: customer route for AI concerns.

Title: Communication of incidents
What it asks (paraphrased): Tell affected parties about AI incidents
Justification: AI incidents can be data incidents.
Evidence held / required: Held: CGI-POL-005 customer and regulator communications (RS.CO = 2). Required: AI incident type.

Title: Information for interested parties
What it asks (paraphrased): Decide what to tell interested parties about AI and tell them
Justification: Customers on calls are not told they are transcribed.
Evidence held / required: Held: none. Required: call notice; AI sub-processors on the customer list.

Title: Processes for responsible use of AI systems
What it asks (paraphrased): Define how AI systems may be used responsibly
Justification: Core control for a deployer.
Evidence held / required: Held: CGI-POL-001 s4.5.1 to s4.5.4 (approved). Contradicted by ScribeCo; cannot reach 3 until operating evidence exists. Required: approved list; review records.

Title: Objectives for responsible use of AI systems
What it asks (paraphrased): Set objectives for responsible use
Justification: Needed to measure the AIMS.
Evidence held / required: Held: none. Required: AI objectives (ISO-07).

Title: Intended use of the AI system
What it asks (paraphrased): Use the system as intended and per its documentation
Justification: Stops drift into prohibited or high-risk uses.
Evidence held / required: Held: WriteCo extension scope restricted (CGI-TPR-001 condition). Required: intended-use and banned-use statement per tool.

Title: Allocation of responsibilities
What it asks (paraphrased): Split AI responsibilities between the organisation, its suppliers and its customers
Justification: All three systems in use are supplier AI.
Evidence held / required: Held: CGI-TPR-001 clause checklist incl. no-training clause (approved). Required: executed clauses for AI suppliers.

Title: Suppliers
What it asks (paraphrased): Make sure supplier AI fits the organisation's approach to responsible AI
Justification: All three systems in use are supplier AI.
Evidence held / required: Held: T2-f and questionnaire domain 15, operated once (WriteCo). Not 3: no review cycle has run (same reason GV.SC = 2). Required: ScribeCo decision; ChatCo DPA.

Title: Customers
What it asks (paraphrased): Consider customers' needs and expectations when AI touches their data
Justification: Cypher is a processor for ~200 customers.
Evidence held / required: Held: none for AI. Required: AI sub-processors in the customer list and the SOC-02 system description.
